name: gizza-ai/ja4-server-fingerprint
summary: Compute the JA4S TLS server fingerprint from a ServerHello

tool.description: Compute the JA4S TLS server fingerprint from a raw ServerHello given as a hex string. Returns the JA4S string (transport + version + extension count + ALPN, the chosen cipher, and a truncated SHA256 of the extension list), the raw JA4S_r variant, the negotiated TLS version, the cipher, the extension list, and the selected ALPN protocol.
